column1: # Run-on speech development set: several thoughts in one breath, no marker.
# Written for the largest remaining framing family. The everyday table reports
# `run-on` at 0/8 on routing and `multi-thought` at 19/40; the sentences behind
# those rates were not read to write this file, and nothing here was copied
# from a held-out set. It is the same provenance as `framing.tsv`.
# NOT held out: these are for iteration. Read the failures, fix the layer, run
# What this set asserts, so that it can be argued with
# A recording carrying two thoughts is two rows when each half would still be
# FINDABLE on its own, and one note when the second half would not.
# That is the product contract rather than taste: Memory is for knowledge
# worth finding later. "The parking is round the back" retrieves under
# nothing once it is severed from the dentist, so RG01 is one note.
# "Okonkwo is chairing the panel" retrieves under Okonkwo, so RS05 is two
# rows even though the panel belongs to the conference in front of it. An
# earlier draft of this header said "same topic is one note"; that rule
# labelled those two rows the same way when they are not, which is how it was
# found to be the wrong rule.
# The guard families are kept apart because two different mechanisms pass
# them and a single rate would hide which one is working:
#   anaphora-guard  the second clause opens on a pronoun or a deictic, so it
#                   cannot be a thought of its own. Mechanical, solvable.
#   bridging-guard  the second clause opens on a definite that resolves only
#                   through the first ("the parking", "the manual"). Not
#                   mechanical, and the row that will still be failing last.
#   object-guard    the second noun phrase is an object or an apposition, not
# On the destination column: the scorer asks whether the wanted destination is
# among the routes produced, so a capture holding a fact and an errand is
# marked `Today`. A missed errand is the visible harm; the count column is what
# Columns: id, utterance, family, expected_destination, expected_thoughts

column1: # --- Errands run together, nothing between them -----------------------------

column2: pick up the dry cleaning call the bank about the overdraft
water the plants take the recycling out
